# routeros_interface_bridge_host (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bridge` (String) The bridge interface the host entry belongs to.
- `interface` (String) The bridge port the MAC address is reachable through.
- `mac_address` (String) Host's MAC address.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `vid` (Number) VLAN ID of the host entry. Only relevant when VLAN filtering is enabled on the bridge.

### Read-Only

- `aged` (String) Time since the host entry was last refreshed.
- `aged_peer` (String) Time since the host entry was last refreshed on the MLAG peer device.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `external` (Boolean) Whether the host entry is present in the switch chip (hardware) host table.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the host entry is a MAC address of the bridge itself or of one of its ports.
- `on_interface` (String) The interface the host is currently reachable through.
- `remote_ip` (String) The remote IP address the host entry was learned from (MLAG and VXLAN host entries).
